disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: With U. Chicago & Algorithmiq, published the sector's first independently verified quantum advantage (Jul 30) — 70 logical qubits, 2,415 logical two-qubit ops, error rates 10x below physical, ~a year ahead of IBM's own schedule; also won $1B CHIPS quantum foundry award
rows.watch for: Kookaburra qLDPC rollout; Starling fault-tolerant target 2029; independent replication of the advantage claim

rows.angle: Willow: below-threshold error correction confirmed as grid scaled 3×3→5×5→7×7; new reinforcement-learning calibration framework now autonomously stabilizes logical qubits during continuous operation across distance-5/7 surface codes, cutting manual recalibration
Topological qubit program + Azure Quantum; Quantinuum/Microsoft collab reports 800× logical-vs-physical qubit fidelity on System Model H2
rows.watch for: Majorana milestone reproducibility; Quantinuum's first post-IPO earnings (Aug 11) as a read-through on the partnership

rows.angle: NVQLink (built on CUDA-Q) now publicly available via the cudaq-realtime API — a universal GPU–QPU interconnect adopted by 17 quantum hardware builders (incl. Rigetti, SEEQC, Silicon Quantum Computing) and 9 national/scientific labs, incl. Quantinuum's Helios and QuEra
rows.watch for: NVQLink adoption at national labs; hybrid quantum-AI workloads

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: Reportedly closed a $1.5B round (May 2026) at a ~$10.5B valuation; broke ground on its Moreton Bay Central fault-tolerant facility in Australia; expanded its DARPA agreement to $125M (Jul 22) as one of only two firms in Stage C, the final validation stage of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative. New leadership team (CEO Victor Peng, EVP Rob Soderbery, CIO Sriram Sitaraman) and a $250K South Chicago quantum-workforce investment (Aug 4).

private_watchlist.name: Quantinuum
private_watchlist.note: Honeywell-backed; upsized $1.68B IPO raise at $60/share (~$12.7B valuation); shares ~$58–59 (Aug 9), down ~24% over 30 days before a ~14% 7-day bounce. Helios system now runs on NVIDIA's NVQLink for real-time quantum error-correction decoding; Microsoft collab reports 800× logical-vs-physical qubit fidelity on System Model H2. First post-IPO earnings due Aug 11 (consensus: -$0.26 EPS, $7.8M revenue) — a real test of the Sol 2027 → Apollo 2029 → Lumos 2030s roadmap.

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: $230M+ raise backed by Google Quantum AI, SoftBank, NVentures; 96 verified logical qubits — industry-leading; now a NVIDIA CUDA-Q/NVQLink integration partner and a selected recipient of Japanese government quantum funding.

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: Most systems remain R&D-phase; revenue today is mostly government contracts and research access, not commercial workloads.

bear_case.title: Valuations price in perfection
bear_case.description: Even after a 30–39% July drawdown, the pure-play trio rallied back toward multi-week highs into and after Q2 earnings (Aug 5–6) — despite D-Wave missing on revenue/EPS and Rigetti's GAAP loss widening to $52.6M. Only IonQ's print unambiguously supported the move; P/S multiples of ~57–483× still price in years of flawless execution.

bear_case.title: Insiders aren't buying
bear_case.description: Insiders at IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave have collectively sold ~$988M in stock over five years versus roughly $4.3M in insider purchases combined (as of Jul 22, 2026) — a persistent gap between executive selling and executive conviction.

bear_case.title: Dilution as a business model
bear_case.description: Pure-plays fund R&D via repeated equity raises; share counts grow relentlessly. CHIPS Act awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and others are structured partly as government equity stakes — another layer of dilution on top.

bear_case.title: Winner may not be listed
bear_case.description: IBM/Google/Microsoft or private Quantinuum/PsiQuantum could reach fault tolerance first, stranding pure-play premiums.

catalysts.title: Quantinuum's first post-IPO earnings
catalysts.description: Consensus expects -$0.26 EPS on $7.8M revenue; the first real test of commercial traction behind the Sol/Apollo/Lumos roadmap since the June IPO.

catalysts.title: Congress moves to boost quantum funding 68%
catalysts.description: A House defense bill would lift annual military quantum R&D to ~$567M as China's own push nears $10B; quantum stocks jumped on the news, with a parallel Senate funding effort also underway.

catalysts.title: Q2 earnings: IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave
catalysts.description: IonQ beat estimates (revenue $80.1M, +287% YoY; guidance raised to $285M midpoint) and closed its $1.8B SkyWater acquisition. Rigetti grew revenue 183% to $5.1M but its GAAP loss widened to $52.6M. D-Wave missed on revenue ($3.1M, flat YoY) and EPS despite H1 bookings up over 1,120% YoY — a mixed set overall.

catalysts.title: Trio rallies on deal news
catalysts.description: D-Wave +11% on a new Nasdaq Verafin financial-crime-detection partnership, IonQ +9% as its SkyWater acquisition closed, Rigetti +7% — the sector's sharpest one-day pop since the July sell-off.

catalysts.title: IBM publishes verified quantum advantage
catalysts.description: With U. Chicago and Algorithmiq, IBM demonstrates three separate quantum-advantage results, including a 70-logical-qubit computation with error rates 10x below physical — about a year ahead of IBM's own 2026 target, and the field's first result verified as beyond practical classical simulation.

catalysts.title: AT&T expands D-Wave quantum deal
catalysts.description: AT&T signs an agreement to broaden its use of D-Wave's annealing technology inside its agentic network-operations tooling; an early test cut a ~1-hour optimization workload to under 15 seconds. QBTS rose as much as 8.6% premarket, lifting IonQ and Rigetti with it.

etfs.name: Defiance Quantum
etfs.summary: Quantum + advanced computing basket — rebounded to ~$153.50 (Aug 8) from ~$141 (Jul 31) as the pure-play trio rallied into and past earnings; still below its 52-week high of $170, ~$5.5B+ AUM; the standard diversified route

etfs.name: VanEck Semiconductor
etfs.summary: Indirect: the compute substrate quantum must beat (and currently rides)

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
positions.note: Delivered the sector's first independently verified quantum advantage this week — 70 logical qubits, IBM/U. Chicago/Algorithmiq, beating its own 2026 timeline by roughly a year — while the quantum program remains a rounding error on a profitable, dividend-paying business.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.note: Willow's error-correction lead is intact but produced no new milestone this week. Also your largest position in the AI sector sleeve — this is leverage to that same GOOGL stake, not incremental quantum-only exposure, so don't double-count the weight.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.note: Topological-qubit optionality is unchanged this week ahead of Quantinuum's first post-IPO earnings (Aug 11), the next real read on the Microsoft partnership's commercial traction. Also held in the AI sleeve — avoid double-counting.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: NVQLink is now the toolchain nearly every hardware builder (17 partners incl. Rigetti, SEEQC) standardizes on regardless of qubit modality. This is also your largest AI holding across two sector sleeves — size for that concentration, not just the quantum thesis.

positions.name: IonQ
positions.note: Q2 revenue hit $80.1M (+287% YoY), beat estimates, and full-year guidance rose to $285M at the midpoint on the closed SkyWater fab acquisition — the clearest case among pure-plays that revenue is compounding faster than dilution.

positions.name: Rigetti
positions.note: Revenue grew 183% YoY to $5.1M but the GAAP loss widened to $52.6M against a $541M cash pile; a Wedbush $40 price target on a ~$17 stock is a bet on the HPE/Pittsburgh supercomputing tie-up paying off, not on today's numbers.

positions.name: D-Wave
positions.note: Q2 revenue was flat YoY at $3.1M and missed on EPS despite bookings up over 1,120% in H1 — the gap between contracted backlog and recognized revenue is exactly the unresolved question that keeps this on Watch rather than held, even as the stock re-rated on the new Verafin deal.
